charity_name.description: The registered name of the charitable organisation (e.g. 'The Sanata Charitable Trust'). Usually near the top of the report or in the header of the trustees' annual report.

charity_number.description: The registered charity number assigned by the UK Charity Commission (5-7 digit number, often labelled 'Charity Number' or 'Registered Charity Number').

address__street_line.description: The street line of the charitable organisation's own address (NOT other addresses such as banks or auditors). Usually in the header or contact block.

address__post_town.description: The post town of the charitable organisation's address, in UPPER CASE (e.g. 'LONDON', 'SHREWSBURY').

address__postcode.description: The UK postcode of the charitable organisation's address (e.g. 'SY3 7PQ').

report_date.description: The reporting/financial year end date of the annual document in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Convert from other formats carefully.

income_annually_in_british_pounds.description: The annual INCOME of the charity in GBP as a number with two decimals (e.g. 255653.00). Look for 'Total incoming resources', 'Income', or the accounts summary.

spending_annually_in_british_pounds.description: The annual SPENDING of the charity in GBP as a number with two decimals (e.g. 258287.00). Look for 'Total resources expended', 'Total expenditure', or the accounts summary.
